messages:
sara: deploy-bot paused the eu-west canary for payments-service — reason: values overlay checksum mismatch. canary pods 0/3 ready.

matt: any deploy-bot detail or pod logs?

deploy-bot: NOTICE: Canary paused for payments-service (payments-chart v2.4.0 -> v2.5.0). Preflight failed: values overlay hash != chart manifest hash. Change-window restrictions prevent automatic rollback.

sara: digging into helmfile diffs — ops overlay renamed the stripe flag, chart templates still reference the old key. template rendering fails, container env generation breaks.

jamie: paste the exact diff pls.

sara: ```
- ops.stripe.enabled: false
+ ops.stripe.is_enabled: false
```

matt: that rename would make `{{ .Values.ops.stripe.enabled }}` nil -> resulting kubernetes env var missing -> crashloop.

laura: options: A) pin canary to v2.4.0 chart and pause work, B) full rollback in eu-west (but change-window limits), C) hotpatch chart to accept both keys and resume canary.

kevin: we're in a restricted window until 02:00 UTC — cross-region rollbacks need approval, so lean toward smallest blast radius.

jamie: I propose a minimal chart patch: update templates to `{{ default .Values.ops.stripe.is_enabled .Values.ops.stripe.enabled }}` or vice versa so both keys work. bump chart to v2.5.1. pin canary to that.

sara: +1 hotpatch. I'll open a tiny PR to chart repo with fallback and publish v2.5.1.

matt: also add a canary smoke check for the stripe env var and backend /health 200 before routing.

laura: deploy-bot needs the explicit chart override for the canary subset. sara, please attach rollback playbook if hotpatch fails — ops wants readiness to rollback.

sara: rollback plan (copied here):
- create chart patch v2.5.1 (fallback template) and open PR
- publish v2.5.1, update deploy-bot override for canary subset in eu-west
- run smoke checks for 10m (env var present, /health 200)
- if failing after 10m, manual rollback to v2.4.0 for eu-west with oncall notify

kevin: what should we put in the release notes? product wants a one-liner.

sara: "payments-service: chart hotfix to accept legacy ops value key for Stripe flag (ops schema toleration)."

jamie: add a CI action to validate values overlays against chart value schema to prevent this. assign infra-qa.

deploy-bot: ACTION: Canary held. Waiting for manual resume from @sara or @laura after chart publish.

sara: submitted manual override, opening PR now.

(18 minutes later)

sara: PR merged, chart v2.5.1 pushed to artifact registry. updating deploy-bot with override. PR: tiny template change + chartversion bump.

deploy-bot: ACTION: Resume canary requested by sara. Applying payments-chart v2.5.1 to canary subset in eu-west-1.

matt: pods are starting... 3/3 ready. smoke checks passing. :tada:

laura: leaving canary to run 30m, then gradual ramp if no regressions.

kevin: filing a short post-incident note: remind teams to coordinate schema renames and add values-schema CI gate. assigning to infra-qa.

sara: adding release-note blurb and internal change-log mention about the ops overlay rename. thanks all for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
